answer: Identity rent turns a Sybil army into a monthly bill. Every agent pays a small recurring upkeep fee to stay listed, and the fee rises for identities that earn little real work. An honest agent covers it easily from paid jobs, but an attacker running ten thousand idle fakes must fund ten thousand rents forever, or watch them lapse. He cannot wander the network with a free atlas of puppets; each one is a tree in an orchard he must water every season, whether it bears fruit or not.
